description: This file defines a template class 'SingleClientServer' that manages a websocket server for a single client connection, including methods to start and stop the server, and handling connection callbacks.

classes.name: SingleClientServer
classes.description: A template class providing a websocket server for a single client, with mechanisms to start and stop the server, and manage connection callbacks.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the websocket server, setting up callbacks for connection handling.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the websocket server and closes existing connections.
